entries.2a87eb04151b93ad: The business that manufactures and sells cosmetics and toiletries and purchases and sells cosmetic sundries, and forms the core of the group. In Japan, Noevir Co., Ltd. and Bonanza Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell cosmetics and toiletries and purchase and sell cosmetic sundries, and Tokiwa Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and Tokiwa Medical Service Co., Ltd. purchase and sell cosmetics and other products. Overseas, subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Taiwan and China purchase and sell cosmetics and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥50,525 million, the largest among the reportable segments.
entries.2ba8545428094518: As the theme of its medium- to long-term strategy, the company has set "realizing moderate growth through sustainable management of each group business", and states that it will pursue five policies: achieving innovation and sustainable revenue creation in the Japanese market, improving brand value, accelerating the diversification of human resources and organization, strengthening competitiveness by diversifying research and development, production and logistics, and promoting management that can adapt to change. As priority issues to address, the company states that it will respond to changes and diversification in the markets for its core businesses, cosmetics and the pharmaceutical and food business, and work to improve brand value and strengthen the competitiveness of research and development, production and logistics. The names of the management indicators targeted and the specific numerical targets are not transcribed here, as they concern future matters.
